capabilities: Searches the bundled Nimble bestiary and compendium
Builds custom monsters, spells and items
Manages campaigns, quests, maps and NPCs
extras: States it is not a virtual tabletop; makes no network requests; full user guide lives in docs/; free to use, with Nimble text bundled under the Nimble 3rd Party Creator License.
problem: Running the Nimble TTRPG from Obsidian otherwise means juggling separate tools for stat blocks, initiative, quests, maps and dice.
summary: Nimble TTRPG companion that runs encounters, campaigns, combat tracking, maps and dice from Obsidian notes, for GMs and players.
